topic: Introduction to Holomorphic Dynamics: Iterating the Complex Plane

sections.title: Prerequisite Refresher: The Complex Plane
lecture_lines: Complex points act as geometric transformations.
Squaring maps rotate and scale points.
Functions transform the entire complex plane.
animations: Draw complex plane with real/imaginary axes in #FFFFFF.
Plot a single point 'z' on the complex plane.
Show addition and multiplication operations on 'z'.
Highlight the distance from origin as modulus.
Fade out axis labels, keep point 'z'.

sections.title: The Concept of Iteration
lecture_lines: Orbits track a point's sequence of positions.
Iteration turns simple rules into long paths.
animations: Draw a simple circle in #FF00FF as base.
Show point z transforming to z squared.
Repeat transformation, showing the path of the point.

sections.title: Fixed Points and Stability
lecture_lines: Fixed points attract or repel nearby orbits.
Stability depends on the function's local derivative.
Attractors pull orbits in, repellers push away.
animations: Display an equation z = f(z) in #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Julia Set: The Boundary of Chaos
lecture_lines: Julia sets define boundaries of chaotic behavior.
They distinguish between convergence and escape regions.
Fractal fences separate stable and unstable dynamics.
animations: Render a path of points approaching infinity.
Render a path of points staying near origin.
Fill the boundary region in color #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary and Visual Synthesis
lecture_lines: Simple algebraic rules produce infinite complexity.
Deterministic systems create beautiful, chaotic patterns.
The Mandelbrot set maps all Julia dynamics.
animations: Show final image of Julia set in #FFFFFF.
Zoom out to reveal complex detail.
Fade screen to black with title.
